title: Does a group Driver B draws behave as a DF wave? On a copy of the trial fort (saltwater river, tropical ocean): the water layer drawn by the tool, two groups at once, a 24 ceiling, a 1-2 day gap, a 9,000-tick countdown, coupling and cohesion on, every water species active all year. Per drawn group: it stays together (cohesion: a school), leaves on its countdown, debits the entry at the draw and is refunded as it leaves, lands in water that suits its body and salinity, and a prey draw calls its predators next.
fork: Driver B's promises (plan rev 2 Q5, W4).

predictions.model: a drawn group is a wave
predictions.expects: every member placed wet; spread under ~12 tiles while led; members gone by countdown + a few days; the entry down by the group at the draw and back up as they leave

kill_criterion: a drawn member placed on a dry tile, or a group that never leaves
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save
a replicate with no draw is vacuous

arms.name: engine
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); cfg.layers.water=true; cfg.water.enabled=true; cfg.water.countdown=9000; cfg.groups.coupling=true; cfg.groups.cohesion=true; cfg.groups.gap_min_days=1; cfg.groups.gap_max_days=2; sw.QUOTA.set(cfg,'water','groups',2); sw.QUOTA.set(cfg,'water','ceiling',24); local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and e.layer=='water' and not e.locked then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; cfg.assign[e.key]={0,1,2,3}; n=n+1 end end; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); local w=sw.ENGINE.waterTiles(true); print(('x2: %d water species active all year; water tiles %d (ocean %d lake %d river %d pool %d; salt %d fresh %d)'):format(n,#w.tiles,w.sum.ocean,w.sum.lake,w.sum.river,w.sum.pool,w.sum.salt,w.sum.fresh))

do: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local g=sw.loadGroups(); local o={}; local all=df.global.world.populations.all; for _,grp in ipairs(g.groups) do if grp.drawn then local here,cd,xs,ys,wet=0,{},{},{},0; for _,id in ipairs(grp.ids) do local u=df.unit.find(id); if u and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and dfhack.units.isActive(u) then here=here+1; cd[#cd+1]=u.animal.leave_countdown; xs[#xs+1]=u.pos.x; ys[#ys+1]=u.pos.y; local d=dfhack.maps.getTileFlags(u.pos); if d and d.flow_size>=4 then wet=wet+1 end end end; local sp=0; for i=1,#xs do for j=i+1,#xs do sp=math.max(sp, math.abs(xs[i]-xs[j]), math.abs(ys[i]-ys[j])) end end; local live,held=sw.RESERVE.of('water:'..grp.token); o[#o+1]=('%s ids=%s placed=%d here=%d wet=%d spread=%d cd=%s body=%s salt=%s arrived=%d leader=%s stock=%d'):format(grp.token, table.concat(grp.ids,','), #grp.ids, here, wet, sp, table.concat(cd,','), tostring(grp.body), tostring(grp.salt), grp.arrived, tostring(grp.leader), live+held) end end; print('x2 groups: '..(#o>0 and table.concat(o,' || ') or 'none')..' | couple='..tostring(g.water_couple and g.water_couple.prey)..' | '..sw.ENGINE.status(sw.loadConfig(), g))
